casual.title: ☕ Ordering Coffee at Starbucks
casual.subtitle: 星巴克点餐常用地道句型

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to order an iced oat milk latte, please.
sentences.cn: 嗨，请给我点一杯冰燕麦奶拿铁。
sentences.ipa: /haɪ, aɪd laɪk tuː ˈɔːrdər ən aɪst oʊt mɪlk ˈlɑːteɪ, pliːz/

sentences.en: Could I get that with less ice and a splash of vanilla syrup?
sentences.cn: 可以少冰并加一点点香草糖浆吗？
sentences.ipa: /kʊd aɪ ɡet ðæt wɪð les aɪs ænd ə splæʃ əv vəˈnɪlə ˈsɪrəp/

sentences.en: Sure thing! What size would you prefer: Tall, Grande, or Venti?
sentences.cn: 没问题！您想要什么杯型：中杯、大杯还是超大杯？
sentences.ipa: /ʃʊr θɪŋ! wʌt saɪz wʊd juː prɪˈfɜːr/

sentences.en: A Grande will be perfect. I'll pay with Apple Pay.
sentences.cn: 大杯就好，谢谢。我用 Apple Pay 支付。
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈɡrɑːndeɪ wɪl biː ˈpɜːrfɪkt. aɪl peɪ wɪð ˈæpl peɪ/

casual.title: 🍔 Ordering Fast Food & Delivery
casual.subtitle: 汉堡炸鸡点餐与外卖定制

sentences.en: I'd like a double cheeseburger meal with extra crispy fries.
sentences.cn: 我要一套双层芝士汉堡套餐，薯条要特别酥脆的。
sentences.ipa: /aɪd laɪk ə ˈdʌbl ˈtʃiːzbɜːrɡər miːl wɪð ˈekstrə ˈkrɪspi fraɪz/

sentences.en: Would you like to make that a large combo for just fifty cents more?
sentences.cn: 只需再加 50 美分就可以升级为超大号套餐，需要吗？
sentences.ipa: /wʊd juː laɪk tuː meɪk ðæt ə lɑːrdʒ ˈkɑːmboʊ fɔːr dʒʌst ˈfɪfti sents mɔːr/

sentences.en: No thanks, regular is fine. Please hold the pickles.
sentences.cn: 不用了，普通大小时就好。请不要放酸菜/酸黄瓜。
sentences.ipa: /noʊ θæŋks, ˈreɡjələr ɪz faɪn. pliːz hoʊld ðə ˈpɪklz/

casual.title: 🌴 Weekend Relaxation & Hobbies
casual.subtitle: 聊聊周末休假与户外活动

sentences.en: Do you have any exciting plans for the upcoming weekend?
sentences.cn: 这个周末你有什么有趣的计划吗？
sentences.ipa: /duː juː hæv ˈeni ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ plænz fɔːr ðə ˈʌpkʌmɪŋ ˈwiːkend/

sentences.en: I'm thinking about going hiking in the mountains to recharge.
sentences.cn: 我打算去山里徒步，放松充会儿电。
sentences.ipa: /aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈhaɪkɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntnz tuː riːˈtʃɑːrdʒ/

sentences.en: That sounds amazing! Fresh air and nature always clear my mind.
sentences.cn: 听起来太棒了！新鲜空气和大自然总能让我头脑清爽。
sentences.ipa: /ðæt saʊndz əˈmeɪzɪŋ! freʃ er ænd ˈneɪtʃər ˈɔːlweɪz klɪər maɪ maɪnd/

casual.title: 🎬 Movies & Binge-Watching Netflix
casual.subtitle: 聊电影与热播美剧交流

sentences.en: Have you watched the latest sci-fi movie trending online?
sentences.cn: 你看网上最近超火的那部科幻电影了吗？
sentences.ipa: /hæv juː wɑːtʃt ðə ˈleɪtɪst ˈsaɪ faɪ ˈmuːvi ˈtrendɪŋ ˈɑːnlaɪn/

sentences.en: Not yet, but it's on my watchlist. No spoilers please!
sentences.cn: 还没呢，但在我的待看清单上。请千万别剧透哦！
sentences.ipa: /nɑːt jet, bʌt ɪts ɑːn maɪ ˈwɑːtʃlɪst. noʊ ˈspɔɪlərz pliːz/

sentences.en: Excuse me, where can I find organic extra virgin olive oil?
sentences.cn: 打扰一下，请问有机特级初榨橄榄油在哪一栏？
sentences.ipa: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, wer kæn aɪ faɪnd ɔːrˈɡænɪk ˈekstrə ˈvɜːrdʒɪn ˈɑːlɪv ɔɪl/

sentences.en: It's in aisle four, right next to the baking supplies.
sentences.cn: 在第四过道，就在烘焙用品隔壁。
sentences.ipa: /ɪts ɪn aɪl fɔːr, raɪt nekst tuː ðə ˈbeɪkɪŋ səˈplaɪz/

workplace.title: 💼 Job Interview Self-Introduction
workplace.subtitle: 求职面试高频自述句型

sentences.en: Thank you for giving me this opportunity to introduce myself.
sentences.cn: 感谢您给我这次自我介绍的机会。
sentences.ipa: /θæŋk juː fɔːr ˈɡɪvɪŋ miː ðɪs ˌɑːpərˈtuːnəti tuː ˌɪntrəˈduːs maɪˈself/

sentences.en: I have over five years of experience in full-stack software engineering.
sentences.cn: 我在全栈软件工程领域拥有超过五年的工作经验。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ hæv ˈoʊvər faɪv jɪərz əv ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪn fʊl stæk ˈsɔːftwer ˌendʒɪˈnɪrɪŋ/

sentences.en: My key strength lies in solving complex technical problems under tight deadlines.
sentences.cn: 我的核心优势在于能在紧迫的时间节点下解决复杂的技术问题。
sentences.ipa: /maɪ kiː streŋθ laɪz ɪn ˈsɑːlvɪŋ kəmˈpleks ˈteknɪkl ˈprɑːbləmz ˈʌndər taɪt ˈdedlaɪnz/

workplace.title: 📊 Project Status Meeting Update
workplace.subtitle: 团队例会中汇报项目进展

sentences.en: I'd like to share a brief status update on our new feature release.
sentences.cn: 我想就新功能发布进展做一个简要汇报。
sentences.ipa: /aɪd laɪk tuː ʃer ə briːf ˈstætəs ˌʌpˈdeɪt ɑːn aʊər nuː ˈfiːtʃər rɪˈliːs/

sentences.en: We are currently right on schedule to complete QA testing by Friday afternoon.
sentences.cn: 目前进度正常，预计周五下午前完成质量测试。
sentences.ipa: /wiː ɑːr ˈkɜːrəntli raɪt ɑːn ˈskedʒuːl tuː kəmˈpliːt testɪŋ baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn/

workplace.title: 📧 Professional Email Alignment
workplace.subtitle: 邮件需求对齐与商务确认

sentences.en: I am writing to follow up on our previous discussion regarding the contract details.
sentences.cn: 写此信是为了跟进我们此前关于合同细节的讨论。
sentences.ipa: /aɪ æm ˈraɪtɪŋ tuː ˈfɑːloʊ ʌp ɑːn aʊər ˈpriːviəs dɪˈskʌʃn rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ ðə ˈkɑːntrækt dɪˈteɪlz/

sentences.en: Please find attached the revised proposal for your review.
sentences.cn: 请查收附件中修改后的方案供您审阅。
sentences.ipa: /pliːz faɪnd əˈtætʃt ðə rɪˈvaɪzd prəˈpoʊzl fɔːr jʊər rɪˈvjuː/

workplace.title: 🤝 Client Product Pitch & Negotiation
workplace.subtitle: 客户演示与商务条款谈判

sentences.en: Our platform offers seamless integration with your existing enterprise workflow.
sentences.cn: 我们的平台能无缝无感地集成到贵公司现有的企业工作流中。
sentences.ipa: /aʊər ˈplæt fɔːrm ˈɔːfərz ˈsiːmləs ˌɪntɪˈɡreɪʃn wɪð jʊər ɪɡˈzɪstɪŋ ˈentərpraɪz ˈwɜːrkfloʊ/

sentences.en: We can offer a flexible pricing model tailored to your team size.
sentences.cn: 我们可以根据贵团队的规模提供灵活的定制化计费模式。
sentences.ipa: /wiː kæn ˈɔːfər ə ˈfleksəbl ˈpraɪsɪŋ ˈmɑːdl ˈteɪlərd tuː jʊər tiːm saɪz/

travel.title: 🏨 Hotel Check-in & Requests
travel.subtitle: 办理酒店入住与提出房间需求

sentences.en: Good evening! I have a reservation under the name Alex Turner.
sentences.cn: 晚上好！我有一份 Alex Turner 名下的预订。
sentences.ipa: /ɡʊd ˈiːvnɪŋ! aɪ hæv ə ˌrezərˈveɪʃn ˈʌndər ðə neɪm ˈælɪks ˈtɜːrnər/

sentences.en: Is it possible to upgrade to a room on a higher floor with an ocean view?
sentences.cn: 可以帮我升房到带海景的高楼层房间吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ɪt ˈpɑːsəbl tuː ˌʌpˈɡreɪd tuː ə ruːm ɑːn ə ˈhaɪər flɔːr wɪð ən ˈoʊʃn vjuː/

travel.title: ✈️ Flight Boarding & Security
travel.subtitle: 机场过安检与托运行李

sentences.en: Where is the check-in counter for international flights to London?
sentences.cn: 请问飞往伦敦的国际航班值机柜台在哪里？
sentences.ipa: /wer ɪz ðə ˈtʃek ɪn ˈkaʊntər fɔːr ˌɪntərˈnæʃnəl flaɪts tuː ˈlʌndən/

sentences.en: Please take out your laptop and liquids, and place them in separate bins.
sentences.cn: 请拿出您的笔记本电脑和液体，分别放入置物盒内。
sentences.ipa: /pliːz teɪk aʊt jʊər ˈlæptɑːp ænd ˈlɪkwɪdz, ænd pleɪs ðəm ɪn ˈsepərət bɪnz/

travel.title: 🗺️ Asking Directions & Taxi
travel.subtitle: 街头问路与搭乘出租车

sentences.en: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the subway station?
sentences.cn: 打扰一下，您能告诉我去地铁站怎么走吗？
sentences.ipa: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, kʊd juː tel miː haʊ tuː ɡet tuː ðə ˈsʌbweɪ ˈsteɪʃn/

sentences.en: Please take me to the airport, and turn on the meter.
sentences.cn: 请带我去机场，并打表计费，谢谢。
sentences.ipa: /pliːz teɪk miː tuː ðə ˈerpɔːrt, ænd tɜːrn ɑːn ðə ˈmiːtər/

idioms.title: 🌟 Part 1: Top 10 High-Frequency Oral Idioms
idioms.subtitle: 地道习惯用语与金句卡片 (一)

sentences.en: Let's call it a day! We've made great progress today.
sentences.cn: 今天就到此为止收工吧！我们今天进展很大。
sentences.ipa: /lets kɔːl ɪt ə deɪ! wiːv meɪd ɡreɪt ˈprɑːɡres təˈdeɪ/

sentences.en: You hit the nail on the head! That's exactly what I meant.
sentences.cn: 你说得一针见血！我就是这个意思。
sentences.ipa: /juː hɪt ðə neɪl ɑːn ðə hed! ðæts ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ ment/

vocab.word: hit the nail on the head

sentences.en: Break a leg! You are going to rock the stage tonight.
sentences.cn: 祝你演出成功！你今晚一定会惊艳全场的。
sentences.ipa: /breɪk ə leɡ! juː ɑːr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː rɑːk ðə steɪdʒ təˈnaɪt/

sentences.en: Piece of cake! I can handle this assignment easily.
sentences.cn: 小菜一碟！这项任务对我来说轻而易举。
sentences.ipa: /piːs əv keɪk! aɪ kæn ˈhændl ðɪs əˈsaɪnmənt ˈiːzəli/

idioms.title: 🔥 Part 2: Trendy American Native Slang
idioms.subtitle: 地道美式俚语与高频口语表达 (二)

sentences.en: No biggie! Don't worry about the small delay.
sentences.cn: 没关系/小事一桩！别担心这点微小的延迟。
sentences.ipa: /noʊ ˈbɪɡi! doʊnt ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ðə smɔːl dɪˈleɪ/

sentences.en: I'm feeling under the weather today, so I might stay home.
sentences.cn: 我今天身体有点不太舒服，所以可能待在家里。
sentences.ipa: /aɪm ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə ˈweðər təˈdeɪ, soʊ aɪ maɪt steɪ hoʊm/

sentences.en: Bite the bullet and face the upcoming challenge brave.
sentences.cn: 咬紧牙关，勇敢面对即将来临的挑战。
sentences.ipa: /baɪt ðə ˈbʊlɪt ænd feɪs ðə ˈʌpkʌmɪŋ ˈtʃælɪndʒ breɪv/
